observations.behavior: Adds a new exception class `ConfigValueError` to replace opaque, value-leaking errors from type conversion failures.
observations.posthog_connection: Replaces the default Python exception raised when a config value cannot be converted to its declared type, preventing sensitive user input from appearing in error logs.

observations.behavior: Wraps the conversion call in a try-except block to raise the new `ConfigValueError` instead of the original conversion error.

observations.posthog_connection: Changes the error handling in `_convert_value` to raise a custom exception rather than the original conversion error, which could leak user input.

observations.behavior: Adds checks in `validate_config` to run the converter and catch conversion failures, adding an error to the list if conversion fails.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the validation behavior to catch conversion failures and report them as errors rather than passing the invalid value to later configuration steps.
